en: Hehehe... I obtained power. That is all...{wait}{clear}Oh, this sword is stirring. It wants to see the blood of the angel's hero...!

Awful! This is too awful.

I'll defeat you before you cause many people trouble.

What a... nasty affair...
I will never allow that!
